final_message:
All 13 tests pass. Summary of changes:

**`inventory/pricing.py`**
- `parse_price`: now strips `,` thousands separators and handles accounting-style parentheses (`"(12.00)"` → `Decimal("-12.00")`), which previously raised `InvalidOperation`. Added type hints.
- `apply_discount`: now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_UP` (the docstring's commercial rule) instead of the default banker's rounding, so `10.05` at 10% gives `9.05`. Added type hints.

**`inventory/report.py`**
- `low_stock`: fixed the comparison to be strictly below the threshold (`<` instead of `<=`) and sorts names case-insensitively as documented. Added type hints.
- `total_value`: added type hints (logic was already correct).

**`inventory/export.py`**
- `to_csv_row`: implemented RFC 4180 quoting — names containing a comma or double quote are wrapped in quotes with inner quotes doubled. Added type hints.

**`tests/test_regressions.py`** (new): one regression test per bug fixed (7 tests).

**`CHANGELOG.md`**: added four `- fix(<function>): ...` bullets under `## Unreleased`.

Existing tests in `tests/` were not modified.
